body: Picked one of the three concrete design options this item's own text suggested ('more quotes on repeated clicks?') rather than inventing a new direction. Sourced two new quotes from real, already-published material -- not written fresh for this box -- from the OKEMILY blog's own Fable/Claude guest posts that already reference TYLER (Clean Builds First, Activation #114), exactly matching this item's other suggested tie-in. First triple-click reveal is unchanged from the original (same s00e00 line); each subsequent reveal cycles to the next real quote and wraps. Verified the extracted click-handler logic through a full 4-reveal cycle with a Node/DOM-stub harness before ever deploying, then live-verified the actual deployed page on okemily.com. Commit 967c1e0.
title: S162-02: expanded TYLER easter egg to a rotation of 3 real quotes
